analysis: The only change in docs/provider/cli-reference.md is a documentation-only edit: the 'Last updated' date moves to 2026-11-05, and a paragraph is added at head lines 1577-1588 about using timeIntervalSince(_:) instead of Date >= / <= comparisons. It cites scripts/check-date-comparisons.py and scripts/check-provider-weak-imports.py as guards against weak Foundation imports on pre-release macOS 27.2. The supplied units are base text around lines 1590-2484, which is unchanged context. I examined them against the threat model and found no new attack surface, no control removal, no change to the TB-002 or TB-011 authorization flows, no change to the prefix-cache or at-rest storage posture in T-041, no change to uninstall, logout or token semantics (A-008), and no change to the add-on sandbox boundaries (TB-012, TB-013). The prose describes a crash-avoidance build check, which is an availability and reliability measure. It makes no security-control claim that could contradict the threat model. Caveat: the actual scripts and Swift source were not supplied, so I cannot verify that the described checks exist or work as stated. That is a documentation-accuracy question, not a security regression. No threat-model update is needed from this change.
